hazards: SEARCH-PARAM CLOBBERING: multiple call sites do `navigate({ to: ".", search: { taskId } })` or `search: {}`, which REPLACES the entire search object. If filters move into the URL, every one of these wipes them. Affected: apps/web/src/routes/.../board.tsx:96-102 (handleCloseTaskSheet, search: {}), apps/web/src/components/kanban-board/index.tsx:67,74, apps/web/src/components/list-view/index.tsx:97,104, apps/web/src/components/list-view/task-row.tsx:148-155, apps/web/src/components/task/task-details-sheet.tsx:55. These must switch to the functional form `search: (prev) => ({ ...prev, taskId })`.

DUAL PERSISTENCE: both filter hooks already write localStorage key `kaneo:board-filters:${projectId}`. Adding URL persistence creates two sources of truth. Decide precedence explicitly (URL wins on load is the usual choice) or the localStorage useEffect will immediately overwrite URL-provided filters on mount.
SHARED STORAGE KEY: backlog.tsx and any other consumer read the same `kaneo:board-filters:${projectId}` key. Changing the persistence shape affects them.

DUPLICATED LOGIC: normalizeFilters, DEFAULT_FILTERS and FILTER_KEYS are copy-pasted across use-task-filters.ts and use-task-filters-with-labels-support.ts. Any serialization change must be applied to both, or deliberately consolidated (consolidation is a refactor — AGENTS.md says stay focused).
ROUTE TREE IS GENERATED: apps/web/src/routeTree.gen.ts is produced by @tanstack/router-plugin. Never hand-edit; search-param types flow from the route file.

ARRAY-VALUED SEARCH PARAMS: BoardFilters values are string[] | null. TanStack Router's default search serializer must round-trip arrays; validateSearch needs to accept both a single string and an array (a one-element query string often parses as a bare string).
i18n: any new chip copy needs keys in i18n/en-US.json; `pnpm i18n:check` gates it.
